phrases: three pigeons in a borrowed coat
the moon owes me five dollars

genres.name: VICTORIAN NEO-RIEMANNIAN TONNETZ
genres.description: Parsimonious P/L/R voice-leading across 4 harmonic regions with Euler G ≤ 8 consonance.

genres.name: 12-BAR DELTA & PARLOR BLUES
genres.description: Authentic I7-IV7-V7 12-bar chord matrix with walking shuffle bass and blue-note sieve.

genres.name: SMOKY PARLOR JAZZ & EXTENDED TONNETZ
genres.description: ii-V-I progressions with rootless 3rd/7th/9th guide tones, swung overtones, and chromatic approaches.

genres.name: PALESTRINA MODAL COUNTERPOINT
genres.description: 16th-century species counterpoint with prepared suspensions, stepwise motion, and strict G ≤ 5 consonance.

genres.name: MYSTIC BYZANTINE & HIMALAYAN DRONE
genres.description: Hypnotic root & fifth drone pedal with Phrygian dominant microtonal scale ladders and open chords.

genres.name: PARLOR RAGTIME & CAKEWALK STRAINS
genres.description: Joplin-style strains: an oom-pah stride bass, sixth-chord melodies, and secondary dominants marching home through VI7, II7, and V7.

genres.name: DOO-WOP PARLOR BALLAD
genres.description: The ice-cream changes, I-vi-IV-V, with a rocking triplet bass and a sweet-sixth street-corner melody.

genres.name: SACRED HARP SHAPE-NOTE HYMNODY
genres.description: Fa-sol-la singing-school hymns: open fifths, the old modes' flat seventh, a stern pedal bass, and fourths and fifths in the bells.

genres.name: ANDALUSIAN FLAMENCO CADENCE
genres.description: i-♭VII-♭VI-V stepping down to a Phrygian dominant with its flat ninth, over a rasgueado bass.

genres.name: KLEZMER FREYGISH DANCE
genres.description: The freygish mode: a major tonic beside its flat second, minor iv and ♭vii, an oom-pah bass, and augmented-second turns.

genres.name: SEA SHANTY & HORNPIPE
genres.description: Capstan and halyard songs: I-IV-I-V in plain major, a hornpipe bass, and an open bagpipe organ.

genres.name: SILENT-FILM LYDIAN DREAM
genres.description: A picture-palace pianist's reverie: major ninths, the raised fourth's major II, and a melody floating on the Lydian fourth.

genres.name: RAW ESOTERIC CHAOS (UNFETTERED VMS)
genres.description: Zero harmonic filtration. Raw, native, unquantized mathematical outputs from all six esoteric virtual machines.
